newsitem.title: USA: US EPA to propose air quality standards Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: US EPA to propose air quality standards Wednesday.

text.p: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency will release a proposal Wednesday on setting national air quality standards for smog-producing ozone and airborne particles, the agency said Tuesday.
The announcement, which will launch a public comment period before a final rule is set in June, is scheduled for 1200 EST/1700 GMT, the EPA said.
The agency is expected to propose tightening the standards, a move backed by health and environmental advocates and opposed by many industry groups.
